decisions: User decision (plan approved in session, 2026-11-12): the task is a slice of backlog item T-008, a config file with ignore patterns only. Custom section names are moved to a new ticket T-027. Ticket: tickets/T-008-config-ignore-patterns.md, issue https://github.com/UBayouski/tracenotes/issues/20.

User decision: the quality gate for coding tasks is saved in AGENTS.md (new section 'Quality gate', part of this diff). action_required and remediation_recommended findings must be fixed when valid; informational findings are reported and left unchanged. The mapping of action_level to High/Medium/Low is the agent's proposal, approved by the user with the plan.

Agent proposal, approved by the user before implementation (ticket criterion 4): a breaking commit is never moved to `ignored` by a config pattern. Order of checks in groupCommits: merge commit, breaking, ignore patterns, type. Reason: a config file must not be able to hide a breaking change or lower the version recommendation below major (AGENTS.md rule 3, Explain Every Bump).

Agent proposal, approved by the user (ticket criterion 9): `group` gets an option loop and now rejects any argument other than `--config <path>` with exit 2 and usage. Before this change `group --x` exited 0 because `group` ignored all arguments (verified by running it on main at 280c2fd). This is a deliberate behavior change.

Agent proposal, approved by the user (ticket criterion 6): the Markdown closing line gains the segment 'P ignored by config; ' only when at least one commit matched a pattern, so output without a config, or with a config that matches nothing, is byte-identical to main.

Agent choice, in the ticket (criterion 7 and Out of scope): the JSON notes document keeps exactly the T-007 keys and schemaVersion 1. counts.ignored becomes merge commits plus pattern matches; the split by reason is not added because it would change the T-007 contract. `group` output carries the reason per ignored commit.

Agent choice, in the ticket (Why this shape, criterion 9): the config path is always explicit (`--config <path>`); there is no auto-discovery of .tracenotes.json. Reason: a run is reproducible from its command line and tests do not depend on the working directory.

Agent choice, in the ticket (criteria 1 and 2): the file is strict. Unknown keys, a non-object top level, a non-array `ignore`, non-string elements, the empty pattern and invalid regular expressions are errors. Patterns are used exactly as written, never trimmed (AGENTS.md rule 6); one leading byte order mark is the only framing removed, and rule 6 already lists it. Patterns are compiled with the `u` flag and no other flag.

Agent choice, in the ticket (Out of scope): no protection against slow regular expressions, because the file is the maintainer's own input; duplicate keys inside the JSON file follow JSON.parse (last wins); README is not updated because it does not document `render` at all yet.

Agent choice, not in the ticket: `compileIgnorePattern` lives in src/config.ts and is used by both parseConfig and groupCommits, so the library rejects an empty or invalid pattern with the same RangeError even when groupCommits is called without parseConfig. It is not exported from src/index.ts.
notes:
Task: T-008 config file with ignore patterns. The eleven acceptance criteria are in tickets/T-008-config-ignore-patterns.md (part of this diff) and in issue #20. Project rules are in AGENTS.md: 1 No Orphan Notes, 2 Nothing Vanishes (every input commit is counted and surfaced), 3 Explain Every Bump, 4 zero runtime dependencies, 5 tests never touch the network or a live repository, 6 Validate Before You Normalize. Conventions: src/cli.ts is the only module that touches process streams or the file system; CLI argument changes need child-process cases in tests/cli.test.ts.

Changed files. New: src/config.ts (parseConfig, compileIgnorePattern), tests/config.test.ts, six fixture files tests/fixtures/config-*.json, the ticket. Modified: src/group.ts (groupCommits and groupGitLog take options.ignore; IgnoredEntry.reason is now 'merge commit' or `ignore pattern: <pattern>`), src/render.ts (closing line, doc comments), src/version.ts (doc comment only), src/index.ts (exports), src/cli.ts (--config on group, render and version; loadConfig; CliIo.readFile; USAGE), tests for group, render, version and cli. Also in the diff, not product code: AGENTS.md (the new Quality gate section), .github/workflows/agent-ticket.yml (one prompt step telling the bot to end with 'Implemented, gate pending'), BACKLOG.md (T-008 narrowed, T-027 added). Nothing is staged; all changes are unstaged or untracked.

Constraints that hold in unchanged code. commit.message.raw (src/commit.ts) is the whole message after the documented normalization (line endings to \n); the ignore pattern is tested against its first line, not trimmed. The merge check `raw.startsWith('Merge ')` is unchanged and runs first. recommendVersion (src/version.ts) reads only groups.sections for triggers and groups.ignored.length for counts.ignored, so a commit moved to `ignored` cannot trigger a bump, and its invariant triggering + notTriggering + ignored === total still holds. notesDocument counts.ignored is groups.ignored.length. tests/fixtures/config-bom.json starts with the bytes EF BB BF on purpose; .gitattributes has `* text=auto eol=lf`, which does not strip a BOM.

Order of validation in the CLI: option loop (missing values and unknown options fail there), then --format and --repo-url (render) or --current (version), then the config file is read and parsed, then the terminal check, then stdin. Only the last --config path is read. Errors are one line on stderr and exit 2: `error: cannot read config "<path>": <system message>` or `error: config "<path>": invalid config: <problem>`.

Checks run on this uncommitted tree: `npm run check` passes: tsc clean; node --test reports tests 161, pass 161, fail 0 (123 before this change; no existing test was edited, new cases were appended). Manual run on the repository's own history: `git log --format=... -10 | node src/cli.ts render --config tests/fixtures/config-ignore-docs.json` ended with `_3 of 10 commits shown; 2 merge commits ignored; 5 ignored by config; 0 malformed records skipped._`; `group` listed the five commits with reason `ignore pattern: ^docs`; a config with an invalid regex exited 2 before reading stdin.

Not tested or uncertain: config files that are not valid UTF-8 (readFileSync replaces invalid bytes); very large pattern lists; catastrophic backtracking; behavior on Linux of the 'directory given as config' test (expected EISDIR, only run on Windows here); whether lone surrogates in a pattern behave sensibly under the u flag.
